description: Safely reloads all server plugins at once — freezes players during the reload so nothing breaks, then automatically unfreezes everyone when the server is back.
body:
# 🔄 Plugin Reloads

A safe and clean plugin reloader for Paper servers.
Instead of using the dangerous `/reload confirm`, this plugin
freezes all players during the reload and unfreezes them automatically when done.

---

## ✨ Features
- 🔒 **Freezes players** during reload — no moving, chatting, interacting or taking damage
- ⏳ **Countdown** before reload so players know what's happening
- ✅ **Auto unfreezes** everyone when the server is back
- 🔓 **OPs are never frozen** — admins can still do everything
- 💬 **Fully configurable** messages and countdown time

---

## 📋 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/reloadall` | Start the safe reload with countdown |
| `/rall` | Alias for `/reloadall` |

---

## ⚙ Config

- Set the **countdown duration** before reload starts
- Customize all **broadcast messages**

---

## 📌 Setup
- Paper 1.21 — 1.21.11
- Java 21+

---
